name: Framework proposal or critique
about: Improve the concepts without forcing artificial task attribution
---

## Proposition or problem

Describe the passage and the change you propose.

## Workflow it should represent

Use a permissioned example or clearly label a hypothetical one. Do not include private transcripts or personal data.

## Trade-off

Would this change make disclosures more truthful and usable, or encourage researchers to reshape practice to fit a form? Identify effects on other interaction modes.

## Evidence and decision status

Link primary sources where relevant. Distinguish an established working commitment from an open proposal.
